[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-1, 7, 8, -1], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // Points for parallel lines var A = board.create('point', [0,5], {name:'A', size:2, fixed:true}); var B = board.create('point', [7,5], {name:'B', size:2, fixed:true}); var C = board.create('point', [0,2], {name:'C', size:2, fixed:true}); var D = board.create('point', [7,2], {name:'D', size:2, fixed:true}); // Parallel lines var lineAB = board.create('line', [A, B], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); var lineCD = board.create('line', [C, D], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); // Transversal points var X = board.create('point', [1,0], {name:'X', size:2, fixed:true}); var Y = board.create('point', [4,6], {name:'Y', size:2, fixed:true}); var transversal = board.create('line', [X,Y], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2, dash:2}); // Intersection points var O1 = board.create('intersection', [lineAB, transversal, 0], {name:'O₁', size:2, visible:false}); var O2 = board.create('intersection', [lineCD, transversal, 0], {name:'O₂', size:2, visible:false}); // Label all four angles at O1 board.create('angle', [B, O1, Y], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'lightblue', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'blue', visible:false }); board.create('angle', [Y, O1, A], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'lightgreen', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'green', visible:false}); board.create('angle', [A, O1, X], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'pink', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'red', visible:false}); board.create('angle', [X, O1, B], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'orange', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'orange', visible:false}); // Label all four angles at O2 board.create('angle', [D, O2, O1], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'lightblue', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'blue', visible:false}); board.create('angle', [O1, O2, C], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'lightgreen', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'green', visible:false}); board.create('angle', [C, O2, X], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'pink', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'red', visible:false}); board.create('angle', [X, O2, D], {radius:0.5, name: ' ', fillColor:'orange', fillOpacity:0.5, strokeColor:'orange', visible:false}); // Optional: label pairs board.create('text', [O1.X()+0.3, O1.Y()+0.3, '∠a '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O2.X()+0.3, O2.Y()+0.3, '∠e '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O1.X()-0.8, O1.Y()+0.2, '∠b '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O2.X()-0.8, O2.Y()+0.2, '∠f '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O1.X()-0.8, O1.Y()-0.3, '∠c '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O2.X()-0.8, O2.Y()-0.3, '∠g '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O1.X()+0.3, O1.Y()-0.3, '∠d '], {fontSize:12}); board.create('text', [O2.X()+0.3, O2.Y()-0.3, '∠h '], {fontSize:12}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Instructions:

Using the Corresponding Angles Theorem, select all pairs of angles that are corresponding.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution:

From the diagram, the two lines AB and CD are parallel, and XY is a transversal cutting across them.

By the Corresponding Angles Theorem, corresponding angles are equal when a transversal intersects two parallel lines.

The correct pairs of corresponding angles are:

  • \(\angle a = \angle e\)
  • \(\angle b = \angle f\)
  • \(\angle c = \angle g\)
  • \(\angle d = \angle h\)

Therefore, any other listed pairs are not corresponding.
